reviewed_scope: Candidate commit only; source review, no browser or heavy test run

verdict_a.six_settings_cases: Retained in the shared acceptance runner: initial change, system selection, rejected-write visibility/retry, retry persistence after reload, latest rapid choice persistence, and latest choice after reload.
verdict_a.guest: Prior native pass is cited by readiness report; not independently rerun in this lane.
verdict_a.admin: Not run. Source links admin@admin.com first-party /api/whoami UUID to extension profile UUID; checks UI admin role and stored admin flag before and after reload.
verdict_a.member: Not run. Source links known first-party /api/whoami UUID to extension profile UUID, observes HTTP 200 admin-schema admins read returning zero rows for that UUID, and requires organization selection before and after reload.
cannot_verify: Native Settings/storage/reload outcomes for admin and member remain unverified until owned native runs complete.

After reload, identity/role/org are verified only from extension storage: profile UUID, token-present, cached isAdmin, and nonempty active-org string. The first-party whoami identity, displayed admin role, and canonical member zero-row admin lookup are established before reload, not re-established after reload.
Member organization selection hardcodes the visible option Matrx's Org and does not independently verify the stored organization UUID against that option or a server membership response after reload.
verdict_a.missing_extra_misunderstood: No missing or extra Settings persistence case found in source.

verdict_b.identity_and_role: Before reload, admin/member identity comparisons are explicit; member non-admin proof is tied to the same UUID by the captured canonical query and zero-row response. After reload, only cached extension storage values are checked, so the runner does not meet the explicit identity/role/org proof-after-reload requirement.
verdict_b.credentials: Hosted wrapper writes admin and magic-link inputs as mode-0600 private files, removes those values from the child environment, and deletes files in finally; receipts contain fingerprints/booleans, not credentials or links.
verdict_b.reuse_and_assertions: Admin sign-in and member identity/admin-check helpers are reused by existing acceptance runners; shared six-case assertions remain intact.
verdict_b.minor_concern: Member organization selection hardcodes Matrx's Org, then treats a nonempty active-org string and selected label as sufficient. This can select the wrong organization for a valid member with another authorized organization, and does not prove the active UUID matches the displayed selection.
verdict_b.test_quality: The member observer unit test checks zero-row acceptance and rejects an admin row or wrong UUID using synthetic protocol events. It does not prove real Supabase authorization or native behavior; that remains the explicit live-run gate. No false live green is reported.
verdict_b.finding: Material: reload() calls openSettings(), whose assertExpectedIdentity() checks local Chrome storage only. It does not revisit Account UI or fetch first-party identity / canonical role proof after reload. A stale cached role/org can therefore satisfy the post-reload guard.

evidence: Candidate readiness report .research/settings-signedin-readiness.json explicitly marks admin/member not_run_peer_gate_pending.
